title: Presence pile
description: Reveal who is present while keeping collaboration chrome compact.
useCase: Reveal who is present while keeping collaboration chrome compact.
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: Illustrative local collaborators. Avatar artwork is CSS generated; no external images or live presence service.
look: Warm off-white page with four pastel circular avatars bearing minimal faces and status dots, a pale round toggle, and a small white name card.
motion: Selecting an avatar or the plus button fans the overlapping avatars apart with a 240 ms ease-out translate, and a name-and-status card fades in while settling 5 px downward.
adapt: The fan-out is the inline `translateX` on each `people` button (`i * 10` px; 40 px for `more`) eased by a 240 ms transition; the card toggles via `data-open`. Replace the `people` array (`name`, `role`, `color`) with live presence data.
